messages:
incident-bot: PAGED: p99 latency SLO breach for route /v1/generate (eu-west) — p99 = 1.8s (SLO 1.2s). Alert group: latency-eu-west. dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/latency?range=15m

oncall-jordan: acked. I'm taking this. checking quick metrics now. :eyes:

samir: saw the spike. autoscaler hasn't spun additional pods in the last 6m. cause look like a KV-cache eviction storm + a few hot keys.

oncall-jordan: can you confirm sidecar memory usage?

samir: sidecar mem is ~95% on 3 pods (eu-west-1a). logs show repeated `kvcache.Evict(key=customer:123)` around 10:42: -- snippet --

```
Evict loop started for shard-7
Evicted 10 keys in 12ms
Mem pressure detected: rss 922MB > threshold
```

oncall-jordan: thanks. maya - any model fallbacks in policy for this route?

maya: yes. we have a fallback to a smaller LLM quantized variant (model-id: rwd-small-q4) via routing policy `route.fallthrough.latency`. can flip to fallback for 10m to buy time. quality regression is minor for short prompts.

oncall-jordan: let's enable fallback for eu-west only. samir, can you add a temporary route override?

samir: doing it now. applying override: `kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: infra.redwood/v1
kind: RouteOverride
metadata:
  name: eu-west-latency-fallback-1744523456
spec:
  route: /v1/generate
  region: eu-west
  model: rwd-small-q4
  ttl: 600 # seconds
EOF`

samir: override applied. confirm traffic is shifting to fallback variant.

ops-bot: ROUTE_OVERRIDE: eu-west-latency-fallback-1744523456 applied by samir. Traffic % to fallback: 60% -> 100% in 45s.

oncall-jordan: metrics: p99 dropped from 1.8s -> 1.05s after fallback. p95 stable at ~200ms. good.

customer-success-liaison: FYI: no customer-reported errors yet. monitored a small increase in end-user page load for customers in EU but nothing flagged via support queue. I'll hold a 10m watch and notify if anything comes in.

maya: good. but we should warm KV cache to avoid repeated evictions. can we run a warmup job for hot keys?

samir: running warming job now: `curl -s https://internal/kv-warm?keys=top100` -> started.

incident-bot: NOTE: PagerDuty incident P-4312 auto-created. Current severity: P2. Acknowledged by oncall-jordan.

oncall-jordan: assigning owner for post-incident: samir (root cause tracing), maya (rollout & fallback config), jordan (incident writeup). I'll stay until 1750. If we need >30m escalation to eng-sre.

ops-bot: AUTOSCALER: requested scale +2 pods for pool eu-west-1a. New pods coming up (2/2 ready).

samir: autoscaler ready, sidecar mem on new pods 40% — eviction rate reduced. cache hit ratio recovering from 0.65 -> 0.92.

oncall-jordan: great. rolling back to normal routing in 10m if stable. leaving a handoff: @maya will monitor canary quality signals and @samir will validate no residual hotkey thrash.

maya: watching evals. short prompt quality delta < 2% per the quick eval. approving rollback at +10m if latency holds.

oncall-jordan: final check: any customer SLA risk? customer-success-liaison: none detected, notify customers only if degradation >2x for >30m.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: p99 latency now within SLO. PagerDuty P-4312 remains acknowledged.

oncall-jordan: closing active mitigation window in 12m unless we see regression. doing quick runbook note: cause = KV eviction hotkey + delayed autoscale reaction -> fallback model + warming + scale resolved. owners: samir/maya/jordan.

customer-success-liaison: drafting a brief internal bulletin for CSMs in case customers ask.

maya: removing route override in 9m unless rollback blocked.

oncall-jordan: thank you all. I'll file a short postmortem and link graphs. handoff to oncall-kate at 17:50 UTC. kate, please pick up if anything pops after I sign out. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: will close P-4312 if no ack activity in 30m.
